dialogues.speaker: Serebryakov
dialogues.text: E-Everyone, please be careful... N-No one got hurt, right!?

dialogues.speaker: Serebryakov
dialogues.text: Th-Then I'm definitely getting fired... No, wait, that's not the point...

dialogues.speaker: Serebryakov
dialogues.text: I-I'll do my best to handle any problems on the train! Um... I-I mean, I don't really know how I'd handle them yet.

dialogues.speaker: Serebryakov
dialogues.text: But the important thing is to try first, right...? Baryatinsky said you have to be ready to act before you know exactly what to do...

dialogues.speaker: Serebryakov
dialogues.text: Oh, you mean the... the Snezhnaya Royal Railway Transport Bureau? It's in charge of just about everything related to the trains...

dialogues.speaker: Serebryakov
dialogues.text: There are safety officers who keep them running safely, conductors like us who work onboard during the journey...

dialogues.speaker: Serebryakov
dialogues.text: And detectives who deal with crimes... I-I actually wanted to be a detective at first, but they said I was too timid for the job. It was... well, it was pretty heartbreaking.

dialogues.speaker: Serebryakov
dialogues.text: N-No, no, it's fine... You're not bothering me at all...
